title: Aura pagination metadata
description: The `meta` and `links` blocks of Laravel’s `LengthAwarePaginator`, passed through verbatim. Aura does not validate them; the pagination bar simply renders what arrives, and hides itself when `meta` is missing or `total` is 0.

meta.description: Pagination state of the current page.

from.description: Index of the first item on the page; `null` on an empty page.

path.description: Base URL of the paginated resource.

per_page.description: Items per page — the value the request sent as `paginate`.

to.description: Index of the last item on the page; `null` on an empty page.

total.description: Total number of items across all pages.

links.description: Page URLs. Informational — Aura paginates by sending `page` in the request.

prev.description: URL of the previous page; `null` on the first page.

next.description: URL of the next page; `null` on the last page.
